maya: Quick intake: external pen-test request arrived. They want 1h log slice + artifact bundle. No DB dumps. Can ops own sanitization?
owen: Ops can do sanitization. We'll redact emails, obfuscate IPs to /24, and drop full query strings.
rachel: For KMS, please avoid granting kms:Decrypt broadly. We should create a per-bundle DEK, wrap with CMK and issue a Grant constrained by EncryptionContextSubset. That limits decrypt scope.
maya: Sounds good. Can someone script upload + manifest with fields: object, sha256, kms_key_arn, grant_arn, presign_ttl, signature?
owen: I'll script pt_push.sh to: create DEK, wrap, upload, create grant, presign. Small example:
```
DEK=$(aws kms generate-data-key --key-id alias/staging-logs --query CiphertextBlob --output text)
# wrap DEK with EncryptionContext {"pt-bundle":"bld-001"}
```
I'll post manifest link when done.
rachel: Add requirement: security must sign-off sanitized sample before handoff. Retest window: 10 business days preferred. If remediation alters privileges, freeze deploys for that service and escalate.
kms-bot: KMS note: use create-grant with --constraints EncryptionContextSubset to limit Decrypt to the bundle. Schedule revoke after TTL.
maya: Action items: owen upload + manifest, rachel sign-off, maya coordinate assessor. Reply :thumbsup: when you ack.
owen: :thumbsup:
rachel: :thumbsup: will review sample at T-30.
kms-bot: Automation: scheduled revoke for grant will be attached to manifest metadata after create-grant completes.
